## Primary Verified Projects
- [daaym.store](https://daaym.store): High-contrast minimalist e-commerce flagship store engineered with Next.js App Router, Firebase Firestore pinned to Mumbai (asia-south1), Cloudinary CDN image pipelines, and two-way Telegram Bot integration for real-time mobile inventory management.
- [Lid Switch GNOME Extension](https://extensions.gnome.org/extension/11675/lid-switch/): Published Linux utility on official GNOME Extensions (GNOME 45–51+) providing instant zero-root control over laptop ACPI lid-close behavior and systemd power management.
- [E-Ration Kerala (ഇ-റേഷൻ)](https://dhyandev.sbs/projects): Modern digital Public Distribution System (PDS) portal and fair price shop telemetry platform for Kerala with bilingual Malayalam/English interface, Supabase PostgreSQL, and Leaflet shop locator.
- [VibeCoding Ball Knowledge](https://vibecoding-ball-knowledge.vercel.app): High-performance interactive football trivia and ball knowledge challenge engine with dynamic question routing, streak scoring, and Vercel edge deployment.
- [DrishyaSahayak.ai](https://drishyasahayakai.vercel.app/#home): Assistive computer vision and real-time auditory perception aid operating at sub-50ms latency using quantized MobileNetV3 and spatial audio cues.
- [FaceAttend.ai](https://faceattendai.vercel.app): Local-first biometric attendance verification system with ArcFace embeddings, Haar Cascade detection, liveness verification, and automated offline CSV reconciliation.
- [FLARE V2](https://dhyandev.sbs/projects): Decentralized disaster telemetry and early warning system combining ESP32 LoRa mesh nodes with real-time browser topology maps.
